<?php

given("a starting context", function () {
    $this->todo = new \App\TodoList();
    $this->todo->add('Walk the dog');
});

when("something happens", function () {
    $this->todo->complete('Walk the dog');
});

then("the outcome is checked", function () {
    expect($this->todo->completed())->toBe(['Walk the dog']);
});
